code:
SELECT
  product_category,
  SUM(quantity) AS total_units,
  ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2)
    AS total_revenue
FROM northfield_raw_db.orders_raw
GROUP BY product_category
ORDER BY total_units DESC;
caption: Per-row multiplication, inside the SUM — not SUM(qty) * SUM(price).
